layers.authority: Tibet Tourism Bureau, applied for by a licensed tour operator
layers.process: Reported: foreigners need a Tibet Travel Permit, separate from China entry, and must travel on a guided tour; border areas (such as Everest Base Camp) need an extra frontier pass.

zone-requirements.note: China's 30-day visa waiver doesn't replace the Tibet permit. Confirm with a licensed Tibet operator.

items.text: Official or co-official languages here: Tibetan.

languages.notes: Signals until the place's own language law and census are read.
